inbox.title: Match Report: Victory
inbox.body: We beat {opponent} {score} in Round {round}. {scorer} did the business. Three points in the bag.

inbox.title: Three Points Secured
inbox.body: {opponent} came to play. We played better. {score} — and {scorer} takes the headlines.

inbox.title: Job Done
inbox.body: A professional {score} win over {opponent}. The coaches will talk about {scorer}'s finish for a week.

inbox.title: Winning Feels Good
inbox.body: Round {round}: {opponent} beaten {score}. Someone has put a drawing of {scorer}'s goal on the fridge.

inbox.title: The Board Is Pleased
inbox.body: The board watched the {score} win over {opponent} and nodded slowly. That is board language for delighted.

inbox.title: Fan Mail Received
inbox.body: A young fan sent a drawing of {scorer} scoring against {opponent}. The likeness is questionable. The joy is real.

inbox.title: Match Report: Defeat
inbox.body: Lost {score} to {opponent} in Round {round}. It stings. Next match, we go again.

inbox.title: A Quiet Bus Ride
inbox.body: {opponent} beat us {score}. The bus ride home was quiet. Training tomorrow will not be.

inbox.title: Lessons Learned
inbox.body: {score} against {opponent}. {scorer} kept fighting to the very end. That is the bit to keep.

inbox.title: Chin Up, Boss
inbox.body: The kit man says every great manager loses one like this. {score} to {opponent}. He also lost the cones.

inbox.title: We Go Again
inbox.body: Round {round} did not go our way. {opponent}, {score}. The table forgets fast. So should we.

inbox.title: Match Report: Draw
inbox.body: {score} against {opponent} in Round {round}. One point each. Nobody sings about a draw. Nobody cries either.

inbox.title: Honours Even
inbox.body: A {score} draw with {opponent}. {scorer} scored ours. The handshakes were extremely polite.

inbox.title: A Point Shared
inbox.body: {opponent} held us to {score}. The analysts call it a chess match. The chess club disagrees.

inbox.title: So Close
inbox.body: So close against {opponent}. {score} it finished. One more pass and this is a different inbox.

inbox.title: Match Report: Statement Win
inbox.body: {score}! {opponent} could not live with us. {scorer} was unplayable. Frame this one.

inbox.title: Goals, Goals, Goals
inbox.body: We hit {opponent} for plenty — {score} in Round {round}. The scoreboard operator has asked for a rest.

inbox.title: Total Football
inbox.body: A {score} demolition of {opponent}. {scorer} ran the whole show. The highlight reel is very long.

inbox.title: That Was Loud
inbox.body: {score} over {opponent}. The fans lost their voices in Round {round}. Worth it, they say.

inbox.title: Giant Toppled
inbox.body: Nobody gave us a chance against {opponent}. Final score: {score}. Cut out the newspaper. Keep it forever.

inbox.title: Shock of the Season
inbox.body: {opponent} arrived as favourites. They left beaten, {score}. {scorer} wrote the story.

inbox.title: Believe It
inbox.body: Round {round}, and it actually happened. {opponent} beaten, {score}. The dressing room is still bouncing.

inbox.title: Not On Paper
inbox.body: On paper, {opponent} win easily. Football is not played on paper. {score}.

inbox.title: Clean Sheet Secured
inbox.body: Not one goal past us against {opponent}. The keeper wants the match ball. The defenders want it too.

inbox.title: The Wall Held
inbox.body: {opponent} tried everything. Nothing went in. {score}, and the back line walked off grinning.

inbox.title: Zero Is Beautiful
inbox.body: A clean sheet in Round {round}. The goalkeeping coach has printed the stat and laminated it.

inbox.title: Nothing Got Through
inbox.body: {opponent} huffed and puffed. Our goal stayed shut. Free hot chocolate for the defenders on the bus.

inbox.title: Next Up: {opponent}
inbox.body: Round {round} brings {opponent} to town. Their manager has been talking. Let the football answer.

inbox.title: Scout Report: {opponent}
inbox.body: The scouts watched {opponent} twice. Verdict: dangerous, but beatable. Set the tactics well, boss.

inbox.title: Big Match Ahead
inbox.body: Everyone is talking about Round {round}: us against {opponent}. Tickets went fast. Nerves are normal.

inbox.title: The Papers Are Talking
inbox.body: The local paper calls {opponent} favourites. The squad pinned the article to the wall. Motivation sorted.

inbox.title: Match Day Approaches
inbox.body: {opponent} in Round {round}. The kit is washed. The boots are polished. The plan is yours, boss.

inbox.title: Climbing the Table
inbox.body: The results are in. We move up to {position}. Keep winning and keep climbing.

inbox.title: League Table Update
inbox.body: We now sit {position} in the league. The board checked the table twice. Then smiled.

inbox.title: A Slip in the Standings
inbox.body: The table says {position}. It reads worse than it feels. One win changes everything.

inbox.title: Eyes on the Prize
inbox.body: {position} after Round {round}. The gap at the top is shrinking. So is the excuse list.

inbox.title: A New Season Begins
inbox.body: Fresh grass, fresh hopes, zero points for everyone. A whole season ahead. Make it count, boss.

inbox.title: Halfway There
inbox.body: Round {round} complete — half the season gone. We sit {position}. The second half decides everything.

inbox.title: The Run-In Begins
inbox.body: Only a few rounds left. We stand {position}. Every match is a final now.

inbox.title: Club Milestone Reached
inbox.body: The club marks a milestone this week. The trophy cabinet has been dusted. Just in case.

suarez_fc.name: Suárez FC
taunts: Handballs? I call them hugs for the ball.
I only bite into sandwiches these days. Promise.
Rules are more like suggestions, no?
Check your shin pads. Actually, check everything.
The referee and I are very good friends. Too good, some say.
We win one way or another. Usually another.
pre_match: Good luck, {team}. You will need it. I made sure.
I have studied the rulebook. For loopholes.
My team is hungry today. Not like that. Mostly.
Play your best. We will play our sneakiest.
The pitch is fine. Ignore anything you find in it.
May the best team win. Or, you know, us.
post_win: A fair result. Stop looking at me like that.
Every goal was legal. Nearly every goal.
We won with heart. And maybe a hand.
Delicious victory. I could just bite it.
The ref saw nothing. Because nothing happened.
You played well. We played creatively.
post_loss: The referee saw everything today. So unfair.
We were robbed. By people playing properly.
Fine. You won. This time the rules worked.
I demand a rematch. And softer rules.
Losing tastes terrible. I know. I bit it.
Well played, {team}. I hate saying that.

kane_united.name: Kane United
taunts: This is our year. It is always our year.
We never lose finals. We avoid them entirely.
Second place is just first place with humility.
We are unbeatable. Until roughly minute eighty.
Our trophy cabinet is spotless. And empty.
You should worry. We nearly win everything.
pre_match: Today is the day. I can feel it. Again.
We have a good feeling. We always do.
No slip-ups this time. Probably.
We practised penalties all week. Mostly the sky.
History says we fade late. Ignore history.
Win or learn. We have learned so much.
post_win: See? Told you it was our year. Finally.
We did not bottle it! Someone write this down.
Held our nerve. First time for everything.
Never in doubt. Only slightly in doubt.
The curse is broken. Nobody touch anything.
We won! Quick, end the season now.
post_loss: So close. We are always so close.
We led for ages. The ending is just details.
Next year is our year. I am certain again.
We ran out of minutes, not talent.
That one went over. The important ones always do.
Typical. Brilliant until it mattered.

haaland_machine.name: Golazo City
taunts: Analysis complete. You lose.
I do not predict goals. I schedule them.
Resistance noted. Outcome unchanged.
My striker is not human. This is not an insult.
Your defence has one flaw. It is facing us.
We do not do drama. We do goals.
pre_match: Forecast: goals. Heavy in places.
We have run the numbers. All of them.
The plan is simple. Score. Repeat.
Kickoff is a formality. So is the rest.
Good luck, {team}. Luck is not a variable we use.
Warm-up complete. Victory loading.
post_win: As calculated.
Of course. It is always of course.
The machine does not celebrate. Much.
Result matches forecast. Goodbye.
That was efficiency. Take notes.
Update complete. Victory installed.
post_loss: Error detected. Recalibrating.
Unexpected outcome. It will not repeat.
Even machines have off days. Apparently.
You beat the numbers today. Impressive.
Logging this loss. Deleting it soon.
Congratulations, {team}. Statistically remarkable.

maradona_maverick.name: The Maverick
taunts: The ball loves me. It told me so.
I invented tricks your tricks dream about.
Genius cannot be marked. Try anyway.
Football is art. I am the paint.
My left foot has its own fan club.
Play beautiful or go home. You may do both.
pre_match: Today we dance. You may watch.
Tactics? The ball and I have an understanding.
Bring your best. I will bring magic.
I dreamed we scored a wonder goal. I trust my dreams.
The pitch is my canvas. Kickoff is the brush.
Watch closely. You may learn something impossible.
post_win: Beautiful, no? Even the goalposts applauded.
That was not football. That was music.
The magic showed up. It usually does.
Some goals are cheeky. All of mine are art.
We painted a masterpiece. You were the frame.
I told the ball where to go. It listened.
post_loss: Even artists have off days. Rare, historic days.
You beat the magic today. Enjoy the legend.
The ball betrayed me. We have made up already.
Every masterpiece needs a rival. Today, bravo.
Defeat is ugly. I refuse to look at it.
Tomorrow the magic returns. Bigger. Cheekier.

zidane_stoic.name: The Stoic
taunts: We are calm. You should worry about that.
I say little. My team says the rest.
Elegance wins. Eventually. Usually today.
No noise. Just football.
You talk. We glide.
Composure is a tactic. Ours.
pre_match: We are ready. That is all.
The game will speak. I will not.
Play well. We intend to.
No predictions. Only preparation.
Small things decide matches. We practise small things.
Good luck. Sincerely.
post_win: As expected. No celebration required.
The game spoke. Quietly, for us.
Control, from the first minute to the last.
A clean win. We will not mention it again.
Well played, {team}. Better played, us.
That is football, done properly.
post_loss: You deserved it. I do not say that often.
We were beaten. It happens. Rarely.
No excuses. Only notes for next time.
A quiet loss. We will answer loudly.
Well played, {team}. Truly.
One word on that defeat: enough.

generic.name: Any Rival
taunts: Nice team. Ours is nicer.
We studied your tactics. It took a minute.
Bring a raincoat. We forecast goals.
Our mascot worries more about lunch than about you.
You are good. We plan to be less polite about it.
Hope you like running. You will do lots of it.
Your keeper should stretch. A lot.
We came to play. Also to win. Mostly to win.
Big talk from a club with small shin pads.
Enjoy the first half. It is the kind one.
We counted your trophies. It was quick.
Save your best. You will need every bit.
pre_match: Three points are on the table. We brought forks.
Both teams want this. Only one of us packed boots.
May it be a classic. With us winning it.
The lads are ready. The bus is warmed up.
We respect {team}. For ninety minutes, slightly less.
Big game. Small talk. Kickoff soon.
Our plan is secret. It rhymes with more goals.
Fresh grass, clean kits. Perfect day for it.
We watched your last match. Twice. For fun.
Whatever happens, we shake hands after. First, football.
The table does not lie. Today we edit it.
Boots laced. Speeches done. Let us play.
post_win: Good game. Better result.
The plan worked. I will pretend it always does.
Three points, zero complaints.
We take the win and the bus home. In that order.
Credit to {team}. Now, about that scoreline.
The lads were brilliant. The snacks helped.
That is exactly how we practise it. Honestly.
A win is a win. This one was also fun.
We will celebrate sensibly. One extra biscuit each.
Job done. See you in the return match.
The table looks nicer already.
Handshakes all round. Especially ours.
post_loss: Well played, {team}. We will be back.
No excuses. Just a better week of training ahead.
The better team won. Annoyingly.
We lost the match, not the plot.
Lessons learned. Several. Loudly.
Congratulations. Enjoy it. Briefly.
The scoreboard disagrees with my plans.
We go again. That is the whole speech.
One bad day. The bus ride will be quiet.
You were sharp today. We were Tuesday-sharp.
Fair result. I checked twice, hoping.
Beaten, not broken. See you next round.

Haaland: Haaland scores. Of course he does.
Minute {minute}: Haaland. The big man does not miss twice.
Ice cold from Haaland — the keeper never moved.
Haaland leathers it in! That poor net.
Feed the machine and the machine scores.
Haaland again — he treats goals like breakfast.
The hammer falls in minute {minute} — Haaland!
Haaland barely celebrates — this is normal for him.
Goal! Haaland was jogging back before it landed.
Yamal: Yamal curls it top corner — a painting!
He's a kid and he just did THAT.
Yamal cuts inside… oh, that is gorgeous!
Golazo! Yamal bends one in from miles out.
Minute {minute}: Yamal makes the ball sing.
Left foot, top bins — Yamal, take a bow.
Yamal dances past two and picks his corner.
Homework can wait — Yamal is scoring worldies.
That is not a goal, that is art class.
Yamal again — someone check his age.
Kane: Kane blazes it over. Sky high. Again.
Oh Harry — row Z gets another souvenir.
Kane leans back and the ball leaves the stadium.
That one is still climbing in minute {minute}.
Over the bar! Kane cannot believe it either.
The pigeons on the roof duck when Kane shoots.
Kane has the power — just not the postcode.
A satellite may have caught that one.
Kane picks his spot — sadly it is in the car park.
He will score the next one — he always says that.
Suárez: Ruled out! Suárez used the wrong tool for the job.
Suárez pats it in with a hand — the ref saw everything.
No goal — hands are for goalkeepers, Luis.
Suárez shrugs. Define handball, he says.
The whistle blows — Suárez was up to his old tricks.
Suárez looks hungry today — keep the ball away from him.
Chomp! Er — we mean a firm challenge from Suárez.
Suárez argues with the ref, the post, and a seagull.
Disallowed in minute {minute} — cheeky, Luis, very cheeky.
He plays fair. Mostly. Define fair.
Messi: Messi. That's it. That's the commentary.
The little magician waves his wand again.
Messi glides past three like traffic cones.
Minute {minute}: Messi does a Messi thing.
He does not run, he floats — and he finishes.
Goal! Messi placed that with a teaspoon.
Messi's left foot belongs in a museum.
Slow motion in real time — Messi scores.
Even the other team wanted to clap that one.
The ball just does what Messi asks.
Ronaldo: Ronaldo leaps, hangs, and thumps it in — SIUUU!
SIUUU! You can hear it from the car park.
Ronaldo spins, jumps… you know the rest. SIUUU!
Minute {minute} and the whole ground yells SIUUU!
Header! Ronaldo was up there for ages.
The knees slide, the arms drop — SIUUU!
Top corner, no doubt, full celebration. SIUUU!
Gravity called — Ronaldo left it on read.
He practised that jump ten thousand times and it shows.
Ronaldo scores and strikes the pose. Calma? Never.
Mbappé: Blink and you missed Mbappé's whole run.
Mbappé outruns the ball, waits for it, scores.
The turtle celebration is out — Mbappé strikes.
Mbappé goes halfway to goal in four seconds flat.
Someone check Mbappé's boots for rockets.
Too fast, too smooth, too good — Mbappé.
The defenders saw a blur; the net saw the ball.
Mbappé is already back for kickoff — that is pace.
Phoenix: Phoenix catches it clean — good dog!
Snagged mid-air! Phoenix will not drop this one.
The shot was going in until Phoenix said no.
Phoenix pounces — ball secured, tail wagging.
Caught! Phoenix wants a belly rub for that.
Fetch complete — Phoenix keeps it out in minute {minute}.
Phoenix guards that goal like it is the good couch.
Nothing gets past those paws today.
Phoenix catches, sits, and stays. Perfect save.
Who's a good keeper? Phoenix is.
Wembanyama: Top corner? Not with Wembanyama's arms.
The crossbar has to look UP at Wembanyama.
Wemby palms it away without leaving the ground.
That is not a save, that is a ceiling.
Minute {minute}: shot on target, arm in the way. Denied.
Wembanyama covers both posts at the same time.
Shooters need a ladder against this keeper.
The Wall stands — Wembanyama swallows it up.
Maradona: Goal… by the Hand of God — cheeky, Diego!
The ref missed it, the crowd did not — the cheeky goal stands.
Maradona pats it in and grins — the Hand of God returns.
A little hand, a lot of history — Maradona scores.
Minute {minute}: Maradona and a very suspicious fist.
That was handball and he KNOWS it — cheeky, cheeky.
Maradona points at the sky — the sky is not taking the blame.
The oldest trick in his book, and it still works.
Diego winks at the camera — goal given, giggles everywhere.
History repeats — the Hand of God, minute {minute}.
Gibson: Gibson dances through and buries it — that's our boy!
The stepover king strikes in minute {minute}!
Gibson sells the dummy and the whole defence buys it.
GIBSON! The shop floor is bouncing!
Twinkle toes, thunder finish — Gibson scores.
Gibson tries one stepover too many… no, it works!
Straight off the sticker and into the net — Gibson!
Gibson's boots are on fire and the net knows it.
Family goal! Gibson wheels away with the biggest grin.
Ellis: NUTMEG! Ellis slips it through and scores!
Ellis goes through the legs — cheeky and brilliant!
Ellis nutmegs one, two… and finishes cool as you like.
Minute {minute}: Ellis threads the needle again!
The littlest legs, the biggest moment — Ellis scores!
Through the legs, into the net — classic Ellis.
Ellis is too small to see and too good to stop.
ELLIS! Grandpa cheered so loud the wall shook.
Tunnel vision — Ellis finds the gap every time.

A neat little triangle out on the wing.
{player} demands the ball. He gets it.

{player} taps it home. Cool as you like.

{keeper} plucks it out of the air. Easy.

{player} hits it well. {keeper} hits back better.
{keeper} holds on at the second attempt.
post: Off the post! So close for {player}!
The post shivers. {player} can't believe it.
Crossbar! {keeper} was beaten, the frame was not.

A big chance goes begging for {player}.
tackle: The move ends right there. {player} says no.
halftime: Half-time. Time for oranges and a team talk.

All over! Handshakes on the pitch.
penalty-scored: {player} steps up... and scores! Ice cold.
Penalty converted! {keeper} went the wrong way.
{player} sends {keeper} diving and rolls it in.

{player} hits it — {keeper} holds on! What a stop!

taunt: Blink and we're gone.
We brought the trophy polish.
Hope you can jump, mate.
You're playing uphill today.
No free waffles today.
Our wall was built by mountains.
Try to keep up with the drums.

clubs.motto: Nice off the pitch. Not on it.
taunt: Sorry about the score in advance.
You look small from up here.
You won't hear us coming.
We had our coffee. Did you?
The sharks are circling.

clubs.name: Croatia

lines.intro: Slow down. Watch. Learn.
lines.win: Age is just a number, little one.
lines.lose: Well played. We will pass even better next time.

taunt: I have seen a thousand midfields. Yours is cute.
We never stop running. Ever.
Bring your best passer. I brought me.
scout: Modrić runs the whole match from midfield.
No tricks here — just passing, passing, passing.
clubs.fact: Croatia reached the 2018 World Cup final.

clubs.name: Curaçao

lines.intro: Smallest island, biggest heart.
lines.win: Tell everyone back home — the island won!
lines.lose: We dance anyway. See you next time.

taunt: Ever played against a whole island?
We crossed an ocean just to beat you.
Small country. Big surprises.
scout: Two Bacuna brothers in midfield — 11 and 12 in the album.
No stars, no fear — they play with a smile.
clubs.fact: Curaçao is the smallest nation ever to reach a World Cup.

clubs.name: Czechia

lines.intro: I can score from anywhere. Even from here.
lines.win: Did you see that one from halfway?
lines.lose: Next time I shoot from even further out.

taunt: If I cross the halfway line, start worrying.
My best goal came from 45 metres away.
Better Czech your defence twice.
scout: Schick once scored from halfway — keep your keeper at home.
Striker Schick is number 20 — and danger number one.
clubs.fact: Patrik Schick scored from the halfway line at Euro 2020.

clubs.name: Ecuador

lines.intro: Ecuador goals are my job. All of them.
lines.win: Who scored? Take one guess.
lines.lose: More goals next time. I always bring more.

taunt: I once scored six World Cup goals in a row for Ecuador.
La Tri never stops climbing.
We train in the mountains. Try keeping up.
scout: Captain Valencia leads the attack — number 20.
Young Kendry Páez pulls the strings in midfield.
clubs.fact: Valencia once scored six Ecuador World Cup goals in a row.

clubs.name: Egypt

lines.intro: I smile. Then I score. Nothing personal.
lines.win: For Egypt, always.
lines.lose: You played well today. We meet again soon.

taunt: Seven African titles. We collect trophies.
We built pyramids. Your defence looks smaller.
Catch Salah first. Then we talk.
scout: Salah cuts in from the right — attacker, number 17.
Marmoush and Salah share the goals up front.
clubs.fact: Egypt has won the Africa Cup of Nations a record seven times.

clubs.name: England

lines.intro: Give me one penalty. Just one.
lines.win: Calm heads, cool finishes. England.
lines.lose: We go again. Next penalty is mine.

taunt: Three lions on the shirt. All three are hungry.
I practise penalties every single day.
Football is coming home with us.
scout: Kane's penalties nearly always go in — unless he skies one.
Never give England a penalty. Seriously. Never.
clubs.fact: England won the World Cup in 1966.

clubs.name: Spain

lines.intro: We are kids. We are fearless. Good luck.
lines.win: Too young to be scared, too good to lose!
lines.lose: We are still learning. Imagine us next year.

taunt: I am younger than your boots.
Homework first, golazos second.
Our wingers are faster than your wifi.
scout: Yamal is the wonderkid on the right wing — number 15.
All the tricks, none of the fear. That is Spain.
clubs.fact: Spain won Euro 2024 with a 17-year-old on the wing.

clubs.name: France

lines.intro: Bonjour. I am the goal now.
lines.win: You cannot shoot over me. No one can.
lines.lose: Even walls learn. À bientôt.

taunt: Our keeper is 2.24 metres of nope.
Shoot high, shoot low. I reach both.
Les Bleus, plus one friendly giant.
scout: Wembanyama in goal — shots and penalties both wilt near him.
Mbappé leads the attack — striker, number 20.
clubs.fact: France won the World Cup in 1998 and 2018.

clubs.name: Germany

lines.intro: We have a plan. We always have a plan.
lines.win: Precisely as planned.
lines.lose: Interesting. We will adjust the plan.

taunt: Four World Cups. We keep them polished.
Our passing is measured in millimetres.
Efficiency is our favourite word.
scout: Kimmich runs the engine room from midfield — number 10.
Wirtz creates them, Musiala finishes them.
clubs.fact: Germany has won four World Cups.

clubs.name: Ghana

lines.intro: My brother is here too. Family beats everything.
lines.win: The Black Stars shine again!
lines.lose: Stars come out again every night. So will we.

taunt: Two Ayews, one dream, zero fear.
The Black Stars never blink.
Our drums are louder than your crowd.
scout: Both Ayew brothers start up front — 16 and 17 in the album.
Kudus is the midfield spark. Watch him.
clubs.fact: The Ayew brothers, Jordan and André, both play for Ghana.

clubs.name: Haiti

lines.intro: Haiti waited 52 years for this. We will enjoy it.
lines.win: Fifty-two years. Worth the wait!
lines.lose: We waited 52 years. We can wait one more match.

taunt: First World Cup since 1974. We came to party.
Les Grenadiers fear nobody.
You have never faced us before. That is the danger.
scout: Pierrot and Nazon lead the line — big, brave, new to you.
No famous names, just heart. Lots of heart.
clubs.fact: This is Haiti's first World Cup since 1974.

clubs.name: Iran

lines.intro: Team Melli travels far. We finish what we start.
lines.win: Precision. That is all.
lines.lose: We fall, we rise. Team Melli always rises.

taunt: Mark Taremi or mark Azmoun. You cannot do both.
Our fans sing for ninety minutes straight.
We crossed half the world to win this match.
scout: Taremi and Azmoun both start up front — twin trouble.
Keeper Beiranvand can throw past the halfway line.
clubs.fact: Iran's fans call the team 'Team Melli' — the national team.

clubs.name: Iraq

manager.name: Aymen Hussein
manager.voice: calm striker who celebrates goals by sitting down

taunt: Score if you like — I still won't blink.
The Lions of Mesopotamia don't hurry.
I celebrate goals sitting down — saves energy.
scout: Aymen Hussein leads their line — calm, patient, deadly.
Zidane Iqbal runs their midfield — great name, great feet.
clubs.win: Good game — now sit with us and rest a while.
clubs.lose: You beat the Lions today — we will remember, kindly.
clubs.fact: Iraq won the Asian Cup in 2007 and the whole country danced.

clubs.name: Jordan
taunt: Nobody believes in Jordan — perfect, we like it that way.
I run faster than your defenders can turn.
The Brave Ones fear nobody, not even you.
scout: Mousa Al-Taamari is their star — pure speed down the wing.
They beat giants at the Asian Cup — never nap on Jordan.
clubs.win: The Brave Ones win again — told you belief is enough.
clubs.lose: You out-braved the Brave Ones — that takes some doing.
clubs.fact: Jordan reached the Asian Cup final in 2024 — their first ever.

clubs.name: Japan
taunt: We will pass until you feel dizzy.
Every touch is practiced ten thousand times.
Samurai Blue never blinks first.
scout: Kubo pulls the strings in midfield — tiny, tricky, brilliant.
Junya Ito and Ueda finish what Kubo starts — watch both.
clubs.win: A tidy win — we bow, we thank you, we move on.
clubs.lose: You beat Samurai Blue — we will study this match all night.
clubs.fact: Japan's fans famously tidy the stadium after every match.

clubs.name: South Korea

manager.name: Son Heung-min
manager.voice: the nicest smile in football, hiding a finisher

taunt: I will smile the whole match — especially after I score.
Both feet, kiddo — you never know which one is coming.
The Taegeuk Warriors never stop running.
scout: Son Heung-min is their captain and finisher — the main threat.
Kim Min-jae is a monster in defence — good luck getting past.
clubs.win: Great game — high five, then we celebrate quietly.
clubs.lose: You beat us fair and square — I'm still smiling, promise.
clubs.fact: Son Heung-min captains Korea with the nicest smile in football.

clubs.name: Saudi Arabia
taunt: We beat the world champions once — ask anyone.
The Green Falcons swoop when you least expect it.
Underestimate us and I will do a backflip about it.
scout: Salem Aldawsari is the danger — he scored against Argentina.
Feras Albrikan and Alshehri share the goals up front.
clubs.win: The Falcons flew today — backflips all round!
clubs.lose: You clipped the Falcons' wings — we'll fly again soon.
clubs.fact: Saudi Arabia beat Argentina in 2022 — biggest shock ever.

clubs.name: Morocco

manager.name: Achraf Hakimi
manager.voice: cool full-back who defends and attacks in the same breath

taunt: Try our left side — or the right — both doors are locked.
The Atlas Lions have climbed higher mountains than you.
I defend, I attack, I don't get tired — pick your problem.
scout: Hakimi is a defender who loves to attack — watch him fly.
Bounou in goal saves everything — even penalties.
clubs.win: The Lions roar again — good game, little club.
clubs.lose: You climbed the Atlas today — enjoy the view up there.
clubs.fact: Morocco reached the 2022 semis — a first for all of Africa.

clubs.name: Mexico

manager.name: Santiago Giménez
manager.voice: goal-hungry hero of a hundred thousand singing fans

taunt: One hundred thousand fans sing for El Tri — hear them yet?
Feed me one chance and the net will know about it.
El Tri plays with the whole country behind us.
scout: Santiago Giménez leads their attack — a born goal-poacher.
Edson Álvarez guards their midfield — nothing gets through.
clubs.win: Viva México — what a game, amigos!
clubs.lose: You silenced El Tri today — the rematch will be louder.
clubs.fact: Mexico co-hosts 2026 — the Azteca's third World Cup.

clubs.name: Netherlands
taunt: I don't chase strikers — they simply stop trying.
Orange is the colour of champions-in-waiting.
Stay calm, play simple, win — that's the Dutch way.
scout: Van Dijk anchors their defence — the calmest giant around.
Gakpo and Depay finish the moves Frenkie de Jong starts.
clubs.win: Tidy football, tidy result — well played all the same.
clubs.lose: You beat the Oranje with our own calm — impressive stuff.
clubs.fact: The Dutch invented Total Football — everyone plays everywhere.

clubs.name: Norway

manager.name: Haaland
manager.voice: few words, all of them about scoring

taunt: Of course we will win.
I score goals — that is the whole plan.
Bring an extra keeper.
scout: Haaland is ice-cold — from the penalty spot he never wobbles.
Ødegaard supplies, Haaland finishes — stop one or suffer both.
clubs.lose: Well earned, kiddo — it will not happen twice.
clubs.fact: Norway's plan is simple: give the ball to Haaland.

clubs.name: New Zealand

manager.name: Chris Wood
manager.voice: friendly kiwi tower, deadly in the air

taunt: Just kick it to the big fella — works every time.
The All Whites flew farther than anyone to be here.
We're friendly right up until kickoff, mate.
scout: Chris Wood is the tower up front — cross it and duck.
Every long ball is aimed at Wood's forehead — honestly.
clubs.win: Good on ya — the big fella did it again.
clubs.lose: Fair play, mate — we'll get you at the next one.
clubs.fact: New Zealand went unbeaten at the 2010 World Cup — truly.

clubs.name: Panama

manager.name: Carrasquilla
manager.voice: tireless engine of a small country with a giant heart

taunt: The Red Tide is rising — hope you can swim.
Panama never stops running, not even at full time.
Small country, giant heart — you'll feel it.
scout: Carrasquilla is their engine — he never stops moving.
Murillo marshals their defence — tough but always fair.
clubs.win: The Red Tide rolled you — swim practice, maybe?
clubs.lose: The tide went out today — it always comes back in.
clubs.fact: When Panama first qualified, the president declared a holiday.

clubs.name: Paraguay
taunt: I smile before the match and even more after it.
La Albirroja never, ever stops fighting.
Fast feet, brave hearts — that's Paraguay.
scout: Almirón and Enciso bring the magic — quick and fearless.
Gustavo Gómez leads their defence like a general.
clubs.win: Paraguay wins and I can't stop smiling — sorry!
clubs.lose: You beat La Albirroja — smiling is harder today.
clubs.fact: Paraguay is back at the World Cup after sixteen long years.

clubs.name: Portugal

lines.intro: Watch closely. This is how it is done.
lines.win: Siiiu! Did you see? Of course you saw.
lines.lose: Impossible. We go again, and I will score twice.

taunt: I have played in five World Cups. You have played in zero.
My free kicks have their own fan club.
Bring your best card. It is still not me.
scout: Ronaldo is their best card. He shoots from anywhere.
Bruno Fernandes pulls the strings in midfield.
clubs.fact: Ronaldo has played in five World Cups — more than anyone.

clubs.name: Qatar

lines.intro: Welcome. I brought tricks. Lots of tricks.
lines.win: The tricks worked! They always work.
lines.lose: You saw the tricks, at least. Next time they end in goals.

taunt: Afif was named Asia's best player. Twice.
We won the Asian Cup with a wink and a chip.
Hope you like skill moves. We have all of them.
scout: Afif is the star — quick feet, quicker smile.
Almoez Ali scores the big goals for Qatar.
clubs.fact: Qatar hosted the 2022 World Cup and has won the Asian Cup twice.

clubs.name: South Africa

lines.intro: I am the captain AND the keeper. Good luck scoring.
lines.win: Bafana Bafana! The boys did the job and the door stayed shut.
lines.lose: You got past me. Very few do. Enjoy it.

taunt: I once saved four penalties in one shootout. Four.
My gloves are ready. Are your strikers?
Shoot all you like. I catch everything.
scout: Their captain is the goalkeeper — Williams, a penalty-stopping wall.
Teboho Mokoena hits rockets from midfield.
clubs.fact: Keeper Ronwen Williams once saved four penalties in a single shootout.

clubs.name: Scotland

lines.intro: The Tartan Army is singing. Try not to let it rattle you.
lines.win: Aye, that'll do nicely. All of Scotland heard that roar.
lines.lose: Hard luck for us, well played you. We'll be louder next time.

taunt: Our fans out-sing everyone. Even when we're losing.
McTominay scores goals now. Nobody knows how to stop it.
It's always a battle against Scotland. Bring your boots.
scout: McTominay arrives late in the box and scores.
Captain Robertson charges up the left wing all match.
clubs.fact: Scotland's fans, the Tartan Army, are famous for never stopping singing.

clubs.name: Senegal

lines.intro: We are the Lions of Teranga. We welcome you. Then we roar.
lines.win: The lions roared today. Senegal dances tonight.
lines.lose: Even lions rest. We will hunt again next match.

taunt: Mané has been Africa's best player. Twice.
Our whole team runs like the wind off the ocean.
Koulibaly has been a wall for years. Good luck.
scout: Mané is the star — fast, direct, always dangerous.
Kalidou Koulibaly leads the defence like a fortress.
clubs.fact: Senegal won their first Africa Cup of Nations in 2022 — on penalties.

clubs.name: Switzerland

lines.intro: Switzerland is precise. Like our watches. Like my passing.
lines.win: Precise. Punctual. Three points, exactly on time.
lines.lose: Even a Swiss watch skips a beat. It will not happen twice.

taunt: My passes arrive on time. To the second.
We beat the big teams when it matters. Ask around.
Climb a mountain before you face us. For practice.
scout: Xhaka controls the middle — every attack goes through him.
Keeper Gregor Kobel is one of the best around.
clubs.fact: Switzerland reached the knockout rounds at three straight World Cups.

clubs.name: Sweden

lines.intro: When I score, the mask comes on. Prepare to see the mask.
lines.win: The mask! You saw the mask. Sweden marches on.
lines.lose: No mask today. Next match it returns, I promise.

taunt: Gyökeres out-scored everyone in Europe. Then did it again.
Isak glides. Gyökeres smashes. Pick your problem.
Our strikers are faster than your defenders. Simple maths.
scout: Two big strikers: Isak the smooth one, Gyökeres the strong one.
Watch the counter-attack — Sweden breaks at full speed.
clubs.fact: Gyökeres celebrates goals with an invisible mask over his face.

clubs.name: Tunisia

lines.intro: My name is Hannibal. The Eagles of Carthage fly with me.
lines.win: The eagles soar! Carthage remembers this one.
lines.lose: Eagles circle back. We always circle back.

taunt: We beat France at the last World Cup. Look it up.
The Eagles of Carthage have sharp talons and sharper passing.
Hannibal crossed the Alps. A football pitch is easy.
scout: Hannibal Mejbri brings the energy and the tricks.
Ellyes Skhiri covers every blade of grass in midfield.
clubs.fact: Tunisia beat France 1-0 at the 2022 World Cup.

clubs.name: Türkiye

lines.intro: Give me one free kick. That is all Türkiye needs.
lines.win: Türkiye celebrates! The crescent and star shine tonight.
lines.lose: You dodged my free kicks today. You cannot dodge them forever.

taunt: Arda Güler is called the Little Prince. Wait until he is king.
My shots bend around walls. Build a bigger wall.
Our fans make more noise than a rocket launch.
scout: Çalhanoğlu's long shots are the danger. Stand off him and pay.
Young Arda Güler can unlock any defence with one pass.
clubs.fact: Türkiye's young star Arda Güler is nicknamed the Little Prince.

clubs.name: Uruguay

lines.intro: I play fair. Mostly. Define fair.
lines.win: Told you it was fair. The scoreboard agrees with me.
lines.lose: Fine. That was fair too. Barely.

taunt: I score with my feet, my head, and... mostly my feet.
Uruguay has won two World Cups. How many has your shop won?
Valverde's shots could dent a bus.
scout: Suárez sometimes uses his hand — the ref spots it every time.
Valverde hits thunderbolts from midfield.
clubs.fact: Uruguay won the very first World Cup in 1930 — at home.

clubs.name: United States

lines.intro: Captain America reporting. Caruso is here too. He hustles.
lines.win: USA! USA! That one is for the home fans.
lines.lose: We will sprint it back. That is the American way.

taunt: It is called soccer here, and we are getting scary good at it.
Caruso will chase you down. He chases everyone down.
Home crowd, home noise, home win. That is the plan.
scout: Pulisic is the star — quick cuts, cool finishes.
Caruso's tackles can stop an attack dead. He hustles every play.
clubs.fact: The USA is hosting the 2026 World Cup with Mexico and Canada.

clubs.name: Uzbekistan

lines.intro: First World Cup for Uzbekistan. The White Wolves are hungry.
lines.win: The wolves feast! All of Tashkent is dancing.
lines.lose: Wolves learn from every hunt. We are learning fast.

taunt: Nobody dribbles past Khusanov. Nobody.
New to the World Cup. Not new to winning.
The White Wolves hunt as a pack. You face all of us.
scout: Khusanov is the rock in defence — fast and fearless.
Shomurodov leads the line and takes the big chances.
clubs.fact: This is Uzbekistan's first ever World Cup.

feats.name: First Whistle
feats.how: Win your first career match.
feats.celebrationLine: Gibson signs for your club. He heard there was a trophy in it.

feats.name: Never Give Up
feats.how: Win a match after being behind.
feats.celebrationLine: Ellis joins up. Small player. Enormous plans.

feats.name: Guard Dog
feats.how: Keep 5 clean sheets in your career.
feats.celebrationLine: Phoenix reports for training. Good dog. Great keeper.

feats.name: The Long Game
feats.how: Play a full season, all the way to the end.
feats.reward: Grandpa Fink joins your club (white card)
feats.celebrationLine: Grandpa Fink laces up. Slowly. But he laces up.

feats.name: The Lockdown
feats.how: Win a match where the other team takes 10 shots and never scores.
feats.reward: Lu Dort joins your club (white card)
feats.celebrationLine: Lu Dort arrives. Strikers, form a queue to nowhere.

feats.name: The Hustle
feats.how: Win a match when the other team's ratings are 3 points better than yours.
feats.celebrationLine: Caruso signs. Ratings? He doesn't read those.

feats.name: The Wall
feats.how: Win 3 matches in a row without letting in a goal.
feats.celebrationLine: Wembanyama is in goal now. The goal looks smaller already.

feats.name: Bite Back
feats.how: Beat Suárez FC in a competitive match.
feats.celebrationLine: Suárez joins you. He says he plays fair. Mostly.

feats.name: Champion of Champions
feats.how: Win the Gibson Cup.
feats.celebrationLine: Maradona is here. The cup gleams. Keep both eyes on his hands.

feats.name: Ten Goal Salute
feats.how: Score 10 goals in your career.
feats.celebrationLine: Double figures. The net needed a rest anyway.

feats.name: Half Century
feats.how: Score 50 goals in your career.
feats.celebrationLine: Fifty goals. The groundskeeper is buying stronger nets.

feats.name: Into the Blue
feats.how: Train any card up to blue for the first time.
feats.celebrationLine: Your first blue. The shine is real.

feats.name: The One of One
feats.how: Own a black card.
feats.celebrationLine: A black card. There is only one. It is yours.

feats.name: Galaxy XI
feats.how: Field a starting team with an average rating of 85 or higher.
feats.celebrationLine: That team sheet belongs in a frame.

feats.name: Friendly Rivals
feats.how: Play 10 hot-seat friendlies.
feats.celebrationLine: Ten friendlies. Still speaking to each other. Mostly.

feats.name: The Invincibles
feats.how: Finish a whole season without losing a match.
feats.celebrationLine: A season with zero losses. Print the posters.

feats.name: Pack Animal
feats.how: Open 20 packs.
feats.celebrationLine: Twenty packs opened. The wrappers form a small mountain.

feats.name: Giant Slayer
feats.how: Beat Legends XI.
feats.celebrationLine: The Legends XI just lost. To you. Write down the date.

feats.name: Draft Day
feats.how: Win a Draft Duel.
feats.celebrationLine: Drafted well. Played better.

feats.name: Hat-Trick Hero
feats.how: One of your players scores 3 goals in one match.
feats.celebrationLine: Three goals in one match. Keep the ball.

feats.name: The Collector
feats.how: Own 100 different cards.
feats.celebrationLine: One hundred cards. The binder creaks with pride.

ALG.flavor: A fennec fox with very big ears. It hears everything.
ALG.passive: the fox listens — {team} hear the pass before it happens.

ARG.flavor: Three stars and a sun that will not stop shining.
ARG.passive: the sun beams — {team} free kicks feel a little golden.

AUS.flavor: A kangaroo that never learned to walk backwards.
AUS.passive: the roo bounces — {team} only ever hop forward.

AUT.flavor: A tidy eagle between two red stripes. Very organised.
AUT.passive: the eagle tidies up — {team} loose balls sort themselves out.

BEL.flavor: The famous little red devil. Mostly well behaved.
BEL.passive: the badge grins — {team} shots take a cheeky bend.

BIH.flavor: Golden lilies on blue. Small flowers, big hearts.
BIH.passive: the lilies bloom — {team} play braver at home.

BRA.flavor: Five stars. They are not shy about it.
BRA.passive: the stars twinkle — {team} skill moves feel like samba.

CAN.flavor: A maple leaf. Polite, and unbreakable.
CAN.passive: the leaf holds firm — {team} never mind a cold snap.

CIV.flavor: An elephant. It remembers every match.
CIV.passive: the elephant remembers — {team} learn from every rebound.

COD.flavor: A leopard mid-prowl. Quiet paws, loud finish.
COD.passive: the leopard prowls — {team} counters arrive on soft feet.

COL.flavor: A condor riding yellow, blue and red.
COL.passive: the condor soars — {team} long balls hang a beat longer.

CPV.flavor: Ten islands, one badge, zero fear.
CPV.passive: the sharks circle — {team} sense a loose ball in the box.

CRO.flavor: The famous checkerboard. Every square counted twice.
CRO.passive: the squares line up — {team} passes click into place.

CUW.flavor: Stars on ocean blue. Small island, big splash.
CUW.passive: the stars sparkle — {team} play with holiday feet.

CZE.flavor: A lion with two tails. Twice the swish.
CZE.passive: both tails swish — {team} always get a second look.

ECU.flavor: A badge the colour of sunrise over the Andes.
ECU.passive: the mountain air helps — {team} never seem to puff.

EGY.flavor: A badge as old as the pyramids. Well, nearly.
EGY.passive: the Pharaohs nod — {team} stand tall like monuments.

ENG.flavor: Three lions on a shirt. Still dreaming.
ENG.passive: the lions roar — {team} believe right up to the whistle.

ESP.flavor: A royal crest with a lot going on. All of it wins.
ESP.passive: the crown gleams — {team} keep the ball like treasure.

FRA.flavor: A rooster who crows first and asks later.
FRA.passive: the rooster crows — {team} wake up fast after half time.

GER.flavor: An eagle and four stars. Built to specification.
GER.passive: the eagle inspects — {team} finish what they measure.

GHA.flavor: One black star. It shines anyway.
GHA.passive: the star glows — {team} shine brightest under the lights.

HAI.flavor: A palm tree that has weathered every storm.
HAI.passive: the palm bends, never breaks — {team} bounce back quick.

IRN.flavor: A badge quick as a cheetah. Blink and it's gone.
IRN.passive: the cheetah stretches — {team} break faster than they look.

IRQ.flavor: Lions from the land of two rivers.
IRQ.passive: the rivers run — {team} keep flowing forward.

JOR.flavor: A new badge at the big dance. It practised in the mirror.
JOR.passive: the badge beams — {team} play like it's the best day ever.

JPN.flavor: A crow with three legs. Extra balance, obviously.
JPN.passive: the crow balances — {team} first touches land just so.

KOR.flavor: A tiger in mid-leap. It skipped the warm-up.
KOR.passive: the tiger leaps — {team} press before you're ready.

KSA.flavor: A green falcon with excellent eyesight.
KSA.passive: the falcon spots gaps — {team} passes find keyholes.

MAR.flavor: An Atlas lion who climbed a mountain to get here.
MAR.passive: the lion stands guard — {team} defend like a mountain pass.

MEX.flavor: An eagle perched on a cactus. Comfortable anywhere.
MEX.passive: the eagle settles — {team} feel at home in any stadium.

NED.flavor: An orange lion. The paint was on purpose.
NED.passive: the lion swaggers — {team} try the fancy thing first.

NOR.flavor: A lion in the cold. It didn't notice.
NOR.passive: the north wind pushes — {team} finish strong in the rain.

NZL.flavor: A silver fern. Delicate looking. It is not.
NZL.passive: the fern unfurls — {team} grow into every match.

PAN.flavor: A badge that bridges two oceans.
PAN.passive: the canal connects — {team} link up from box to box.

PAR.flavor: A lion under a star, guarding the badge.
PAR.passive: the guard lion watches — {team} sniff out sneaky passes.

POR.flavor: An old explorer's sphere. It has seen the whole map.
POR.passive: the sphere spins — {team} shots come from strange places.

QAT.flavor: A maroon badge, calm as a desert evening.
QAT.passive: the desert cools — {team} stay patient when it's tense.

RSA.flavor: A badge with a rainbow behind it. Always.
RSA.passive: the rainbow arcs — {team} chipped passes look extra pretty.

SCO.flavor: A prickly thistle. Handle with care.
SCO.passive: the thistle prickles — {team} are no fun to tackle.

SEN.flavor: A lion of Teranga. Fierce, and a wonderful host.
SEN.passive: the lion welcomes you in — then {team} take the ball back.

SUI.flavor: A white cross, punctual to the second.
SUI.passive: the badge keeps time — {team} never miss a kickoff beat.

SWE.flavor: Three crowns. One would have been fine.
SWE.passive: the crowns sit level — {team} keep a cool blue head.

TUN.flavor: An eagle of Carthage, older than most trophies.
TUN.passive: the old eagle circles — {team} wait for the right moment.

TUR.flavor: A crescent moon and star. Night games feel special.
TUR.passive: the moon rises — {team} glow in evening kickoffs.

URU.flavor: Four stars on a small badge. Punching up is tradition.
URU.passive: the stars stack — {team} play bigger than they look.

USA.flavor: Stars, stripes, and a lot of running.
USA.passive: the stripes streak — {team} run all day and ask for extra.

UZB.flavor: The Huma bird. Legend says it never lands.
UZB.passive: the Huma flies on — {team} never stop moving.
